sections.title: Habit and flowers
sections.text: Rhinanthus minor, yellow rattle, is an annual herb 15–50 cm tall. Opposite, toothed leaves line the upright stem; yellow, two-lipped flowers sit among inflated green bracts in a terminal spike.

sections.title: Seeds and ecology
sections.text: The calyx turns brown and papery around a capsule whose loose seeds rattle when ripe. This hemiparasite taps the roots of neighboring plants, especially grasses; it can reduce their growth and help diversify grassland.

sections.title: Image details
sections.text: The plate shows the yellow flower, inflated calyx and dry seed capsule characteristic of the species.
